comments.author: GrooveypenguinX
comments.body_html:
It’s not even the load in/out animations, it’s the fact that there’s no way to change the amount of animations where you open the top to load a belt.
All the animations are based around a belt-fed magazine, so when you check mag there’s no way (outside of client mod fuckery) to have him check the side mag instead of popping the top.

We looked into it initially, and again before release, and decided it would be too costly time-wise to include side-mag loading. Not until BSG implements it through their code.

… or maybe it will be looked over again before WTT releases. No promises.
